title: Desk Tidy
subject: Timber
description: Design and make a useful timber organiser. Follow the project from the brief and early concepts through drawings, making, testing and evaluation.
includes: Illustrated readings, design activities, knowledge checks, puzzles and a complete project folio.

title: Footstool
subject: Timber
description: Explore timber, tools and design through the Footstool project. Follow all ten course modules from workshop readiness and plan reading to personal design, making evidence and evaluation.
includes: Illustrated readings, original project plans, knowledge checks, puzzles, drawing activities and project folio spaces.

title: Programmable Light
subject: Technology 7–8
description: Connect materials, design and digital thinking through the Programmable Light project, from reading the original drawing to planning behaviour and evaluating evidence.
includes: Illustrated readings, original drawing, design development, paper coding tasks, knowledge checks and project folio activities.

title: Breadboard
subject: Timber
description: Develop accurate timber selection, marking, joining and finishing through the Breadboard project. Record checks and explain the decisions behind the finished work.
includes: Illustrated readings, original project plan, biscuit-joint diagrams, knowledge checks, surface investigations and a complete project folio.

title: Small Box
subject: Timber
description: Plan, make and evaluate a small timber box. Choose an open box or an optional lid with the teacher, and record evidence that matches the version you make.
includes: Illustrated readings, joinery diagrams, knowledge checks, practical investigations and folio tasks for both open and lidded boxes.
